findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 3, Harm 2
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - a Python client configured with `test = "pytest tests"` and no `always_test` changes only the document consumed by an existing test.
The new proof stops at enabling the workflow step; it never executes the consuming test. Generated CI runs `forge test --change` (`src/forge/prcheck.py:237`), which reaches pytest selection through `src/forge/review.py:395` and `src/forge/fasttest.py:282`. That selector considers changed Python modules and shared configuration, but does not select readers of changed Markdown files (`src/forge/fasttest.py:351–382`). With this docs-only input, its selection remains empty and it returns success without running pytest (`src/forge/fasttest.py:618–621`). Consequently, even the expressions covered by this proof still skip their tests in ordinary Python clients. Repair the selection path and extend this proof to execute the real change-test command and verify that the consuming test runs.
findings.title: Not done: A docs change that a test reads through a __file__-built path runs that test

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - `tests/test_guide.py` reads `Path(__file__).parents[1] / 'docs' / 'topics/guide.md'` and only `docs/topics/guide.md` changes.
The candidate search finds this consumer, but `patterns` contains `guide.md`, while the quoted literals are `docs` and `topics/guide.md`. Neither equals the basename, so this new check misses the reader. The remaining literal resolver also misses it: it cannot fold `Path(__file__)`, and resolving either literal against the repository or consumer directory does not produce the changed document's path. The classifier therefore still declares this change docs-only and skips CI. Match basenames contained in quoted relative path components in both this shared implementation and `.forge/review-tests.py:80`; the current regression cases only cover a basename quoted separately.
findings.title: Include relative subpaths in the conservative basename match

why: The docs-only skip misses tests that build doc paths from __file__, so a docs change skips tests that read it (issue 1031)
